The drafts now use an open fundamental box for the conservative remap branch, handle wrapped periodic cells in the departure-volume proof, and state the global error bound’s joint refinement condition explicitly.

The generated run dependency artifact’s input hash also differs from the dispatch hash. I left those shared and other-batch files unchanged.
